name: Gujarat Govt Scheme → Kunvarbai nu Mameru

service.description: Kunvarbai nu Mameru (e-Samaj Kalyan) — help at the marriage of a daughter of an eligible family.
service.depending: Marriage certificate, Aadhaar Card and school leaving certificate of the bride, caste certificate, income certificate, bank passbook
service.rules: Apply within the time allowed after the marriage. Give the acknowledgement to the customer.
